concepts.name: Synthetic polynomial transforms
concepts.gloss: Fourier-type transforms over the polynomial ring modulo y^r + 1 using ω_t = y^(2r/t) as root of unity, so twiddle multiplications are signed coefficient shifts; their forward and opposite versions invert each other up to 1/t.

concepts.name: Recursive power saving from s < Wm
concepts.gloss: A call at parameter m·f makes s calls at parameter f on streams of volume V/W, so normalized cost satisfies F_k ≤ (s/W)F_(k−1)+O(1) with s/W < m^τ, giving cost O(V e^τ) with τ < 1.

concepts.gloss: Adding (XOR) selected bits of one address chunk into another using a constant number of cyclic shifts of whole chunk ranges plus a deterministic repair of a small explicitly identified set of exceptional addresses.

concepts.name: Exact Gaussian dyadics and guard width
concepts.gloss: Intermediate values in a butterfly layer are exact Gaussian dyadics whose denominators and magnitudes grow by at most a bounded number of guard bits, so one truncation follows the completed layer.

concepts.name: Simultaneous butterfly layer
concepts.gloss: Applying H₀(u,v) = ((u+v)/2,(u−v)/2) to the same bit position in d address chunks at once, on polynomial records, in O(V d^λ') time with λ' < 1 instead of d whole-array passes.

concepts.name: Cyclic-to-negacyclic coefficient twist
